scopeStatement: Independently review all 93 Mermaid activity diagrams against BP.ML.s and CL.ML.s. Verify that every semantic code label before DimExpressions has exactly one diagram, that public entry-point behavior matches XOR.bas, ENCODE.bas, and DIPOLE.bas, that internal control-flow summaries are faithful, that Mermaid syntax and relative links are valid, and that README links and the validation receipt are accurate. Apply workspace rules, requirement impact, and the documentation goal holistically. Return full PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN findings plus numeric accuracy and completeness scores.
